name: EXM_MILEAGE_POLICIES
description: This table contains mileage expense policy definitions.

columns.name: MILEAGE_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Mileage policy identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: POLICY_NAME
columns.description: Name of this expense policy of mileage category.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for this expense policy of mileage category.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Mileage policy status, such as Draft and Active. Valid values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_STATUS.

columns.name: CURRENCY_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Currency option selected for the rate definition, such as single or multiple currency. Valid values are from the lookup EXM_CURRENCY_OPTION.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the expense policy when rates are defined in a single currency.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code where this policy is applicable.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE_CODE
columns.description: Unit in which distance is measured for mileage calculation. Values are from the lookup EXM_UNIT_OF_MEASURE.

columns.name: DISPLAY_ALL_UNITS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether expense entry preparers can select any unit of measure in an expense report for a mileage expense associated with this expense policy.

columns.name: ENABLED_ROLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether mileage rates vary based on the role of an employee.

columns.name: POLICY_ROLE_CODE
columns.description: Role type that determines the policy rate, such as Job, Grade, and Position. Values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_ROLE.

columns.name: ENABLED_LOCATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether mileage rates vary by location.

columns.name: LOCATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of location that determines rates, such as Geographical Location and Zone. Valid values are from the lookup EXM_LOCATION_TYPE.

columns.name: ZONE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the applicable zone types for this policy. Values are from the lookup EXM_ZONE_TYPE.

columns.name: ENABLED_ELIGIBILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether there is a minimum distance requirement for mileage eligibility.

columns.name: ELIGIBILITY_DISTANCE
columns.description: Minimum trip distance to be eligible for mileage reimbursement.

columns.name: DISTANCE_THRESHOLD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether mileage rates vary by distance threshold.

columns.name: APPLY_THRESHOLD_BY_CODE
columns.description: Indicates when a threshold is applied to a trip distance to determine mileage rates, such as By trip or By cumulative mileage. Valid values are from the lookup EXM_THRESHOLD_PERIOD.

columns.name: ENABLED_VEH_CATEGORY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether mileage rates vary by vehicle category.

columns.name: VEHICLE_CATEGORY_LIST_CODE
columns.description: Lookup representing the vehicle categories applicable for this mileage policy.

columns.name: ENABLED_VEH_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether mileage rates vary by vehicle type.

columns.name: VEHICLE_TYPE_LIST_CODE
columns.description: Lookup representing the vehicle types applicable for this mileage policy.

columns.name: ENABLED_FUEL_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether mileage rates vary by fuel type.

columns.name: FUEL_TYPE_LIST_CODE
columns.description: Lookup representing the fuel types applicable for this mileage policy.

columns.name: ENABLED_PASSENGER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether passenger rates are applicable for this policy.

columns.name: PASSENGER_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Passenger rate type, such as Single, Range, or Specific. Valid values are from the lookup EXM_PASSENGER_RULE.

columns.name: ENABLED_STD_DEDUCTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether standard mileage deduction is applicable for this policy.

columns.name: STD_DEDUCTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates which type of standard mileage deduction is applicable.

columns.name: MILEAGE_DEDUCTION
columns.description: Distance that must be subtracted from the total distance traveled before mileage calculation.

columns.name: CAPTURE_PASS_NAMES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether passenger names must be captured in expense report.

columns.name: CALC_PASS_RATE_BY_DIST_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether passenger rate must be calculated by the distance traveled by each passenger.

columns.name: ENABLED_MAX_PASS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a limit exists for number of passengers eligible to be included in mileage reimbursement calculation.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_PASSENGERS
columns.description: Maximum number of passengers eligible for inclusion in mileage reimbursement calculation.

columns.name: ENABLED_ADDITNL_RATES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether mileage rates vary by additional rate types.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_RATES_LIST_CODE
columns.description: Lookup representing the additional rate types applicable for this mileage policy.

columns.name: ENABLED_GENDER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether mileage rates vary based on the gender of an employee.
